description: This file contains functions and constants for setting up and managing a development workspace and configuration for the openclaw gateway, including loading templates, resolving directories, and ensuring the workspace and config are initialized.

methods.name: loadDevTemplate
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a development template file, returning its content or a fallback if an error occurs.

methods.name: resolveDevWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Determines the development workspace directory based on environment variables and profile.

methods.name: writeFileIfMissing
methods.description: Writes a file with specified content if it does not already exist.

methods.name: ensureDevWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures the development workspace directory exists and populates it with default markdown files.

methods.name: ensureDevGatewayConfig
methods.description: Sets up the development gateway configuration and workspace, resetting if specified.
